base.meaning: Fixtures, jars (LUCENE_VERSION in scripts/lib-lucene-jars.sh), Version::LATEST and docs/parity.md are pinned here; every 10.5.0-10.5.2 fix is in. Index formats are those of 10.5.x (Lucene104 codec, doc-values VERSION 2, SegmentInfos 10.5).

partial.meaning: Output-neutral 10.6.0 changes were ported on 2026-10-30 (port PRs #56, #57, #58, #60); triage in /mnt/project-files/plan/lucene-10.6-triage.md covered all 202 commits of 10.5.2..10.6.0. Output-changing items and the read side of the 10.6 formats were deliberately left until the pin is bumped.

notes: ported_prs lists upstream PR numbers from 10.5.2..10.6.0 that the port has taken; skipped_prs have a measured reason. scripts/lucene-upstream-diff.py reads both and also treats a PR number mentioned anywhere in the repo as 'referenced'. Update this file in the same PR that ports or rejects a change; bump base when the pin moves.
